editorial.name: Color Ramp
editorial.descriptionZh: 输入一个基准色就生成整条 WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA 合规色阶的网页工具，色阶可导出 JSON 交给它的 Figma 插件。
editorial.takeawayZh: 输基准色出合规色阶，导 JSON 进 Figma
editorial.noteZh: 深色星空底上左边是 Create accessible color ramps in less than 5 seconds, no BS. 的大标题，旁边手写体补了一句 Not even Claude can do it this fast!；顶栏右侧写着 Choose your color space: 加 OKLCH、HSL 两个按钮，再往右是 Buy me a coffee :) 和一个暂停键。右边一整块由五列色阶拼成的色板，底下调侃 Guess what these color ramps were created with。往下是 Get to gettin'! 与 Figma Plugin 入口，Powerful Features 一节从上到下列了 Extreme Speed、Accessibility Focus、Import Ramps to Figma、Contrast Ratios、Color Uniqueness、Lightest Light and Darkest Dark、Choose Default Mode、Last Used Color。

reasons.statement: 交付物是从基准色现场生成的色阶与它的导出文件，用户动作是输入、生成、导出，属创作工具；沿用本仓库把配色生成器归 image-vector-layout-creation 的口径。
页面自述强调 Accessibility Focus 与 WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA，但它生成色阶而不是审计既有页面，所以不归 accessibility-audit-remediation。

pages.title: Color Ramp - Create accessible color ramps in less than 5 seconds, no BS.
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Color Ramp 首屏：Create accessible color ramps in less than 5 seconds, no BS.

facts.evidence: 正文写着 every shade generated meets WCAG 2.2 AA and AAA standards，Features 一节的 Accessibility Focus 也是同一说法
顶栏按钮与正文都写着 Choose your color space: OKLCH HSL，对应 /index-oklch.html 与 /index-hsl.html 两条路径

facts.value: 导出 JSON，用 Figma Community 上的插件导入
facts.evidence: Import Ramps to Figma 一段写 Export your ramp as JSON and bring it straight into Figma with a single import，并指到 Figma Community

facts.value: 每级色阶给出对白色与深色底的对比度
facts.evidence: Contrast Ratios 一段写 Each shade shows your contrast ratio for both white and deep-dark backgrounds
页面只有 Buy me a coffee 的打赏入口，没有付费墙
